project_type: Next.js 14 frontend with TypeScript + Radix UI component library
build_system: Next.js with npm - standard React build process
test_framework: None currently configured - manual testing required
test_command: npm run type-check && npm run lint
verification_instructions: Run build command to ensure TypeScript compilation passes. Manual testing with keyboard navigation and screen readers required for accessibility verification.
snapshot_or_generated_files: None - Next.js generates .next build artifacts automatically
environment_constraints: Frontend-only changes, no server restarts needed. Uses Radix UI components which provide accessibility foundation
contribution_requirements: WCAG 2.1 Level AA compliance required per task16-accessibility-plan.md. Focus on keyboard navigation, ARIA attributes, screen reader support, and focus management
key_patterns: Components use Radix UI primitives, custom Button/Input/Form components in ui/, hooks-based state management, className prop pattern with cn() utility
directory_structure: src/components/ contains ui/ (primitive components), layout/ (navigation), forms/, table/, charts/, loading/, notifications/. Each component follows React FC pattern with TypeScript props interfaces
